result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations: linear combinations of partial derivative operators $\partial_{z_1},\partial_{z_2}$ in terms of $\partial_{y_1..4}$ with coefficients $\alpha$, and a theta-like series with quadratic exponent $\frac{a}{2}m^2+bmn+\frac{c}{2}n^2$ and conditions on characteristics; a rotated column on the left shows a linear system with coefficients $a_{ij}$.
result.transcription:
$\partial_{z_1} = \alpha_1^1\partial_{y_1} + \alpha_1^2\partial_{y_2} + \alpha_1^3\partial_{y_3} + \alpha_1^4\partial_{y_4}$
$\partial_{z_2} = \alpha_2^1\partial_{y_1} + \alpha_2^2\partial_{y_2} + \alpha_2^3\partial_{y_3} + \alpha_2^4\partial_{y_4}$
[-$\alpha_2^4\partial z_1 - \alpha_1^4\partial z_2 = p+qi$-]
[-$\alpha_2^4\partial z_1 - \alpha_1^4\partial z_2 = r+si$-]
[-$(pr)^2+(qr)^2+(ps)^2+(qs)^2$-]
$\frac{\partial z_1}{\alpha_1^4} - \frac{\partial z_2}{\alpha_2^4} = \partial p + \partial q i$
$\frac{\overline{\partial z_1}}{\overline{\alpha_1^4}} - \frac{\overline{\partial z_2}}{\overline{\alpha_2^4}} = \partial p + \partial q i$[?]
[-$(p r)^2+(pq)^2+(pr)^2+(qr)^2$-]
[-$\alpha_2^4\partial z_1 - \alpha_1^4\partial z_2 =$-]

$\overline{\alpha_1^4}\partial z_2 - \alpha_2^4\overline{\partial z_1} = -r-si$
[-$\overline{\alpha_2^4}\overline{\partial z_1} - \alpha_1^4\partial z_2 = p-qi$-]
[-$\alpha_1^4\overline{\partial z_2} - \overline{\alpha_2^4}\partial z_1 = -r+si$-]
$f(x, y) = 0$
$\alpha = \frac12 - \frac a2 - \frac b2 \quad \alpha = -\frac a2 - \frac b2$
$\beta = -\frac c2 - \frac b2 \quad \beta = \frac12 - \frac b2 - \frac c2$
$1 + e^{2\pi i(\frac a2 m^2 + bmn + \frac c2 n^2)}(e^{\alpha m+\beta n} + e^{-\alpha m - \beta n})$
$f(x,y) = \sum e^{2\pi i \frac14(\frac a2 i^2 + b i i' + \frac c2 i'^2) + \frac12\alpha\frac{i+1}{2} + \beta\frac{i'+1}{2}}$
$= \frac{2i+1}{8}a + b\frac{i+i'+1}{4}$
$+ \frac{2i'+1}{8}c$

$+ \frac\alpha2 + \frac\beta2 + \frac a8 + \frac b4 + \frac c8$
$\cos\frac{i\pi}{2} = 0$
$\cos 2\pi(i(\frac\alpha2+\frac a4+\frac b4) + i'(\frac\beta2+\frac c4+\frac b4))$
$\frac\alpha2 + \frac a4 + \frac b4 = \frac14 \quad | \quad \frac\alpha2 + \frac a4 + \frac b4 = 0$

methods.what: Expression of derivatives with respect to complex variables as linear combinations of derivatives in four real variables
Theta series in two variables with characteristics; determining characteristics for which the series vanishes via cosine condition
Conditions on characteristics for odd theta (vanishing)
Determinant of matrix $\alpha_i\alpha_k - m a_{ik}$ (characteristic-type determinant of quadratic form)
